'''''Charlie''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] employed by [[Airam Clans|Airam]] [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Cargo ferry was part of Tamaron's arrangement at [[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]] to restock the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with new [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]]. However, [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] lead by [[Ilay]] a rival clan leader and ally with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] arrived to attack the rendezvous area, followed by [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']] hoping to stop the operation, but [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadrons]] provided fighter support to complete the transaction between both Airam and Rebel ships and all cargo ferries, including ''Charlie'' would escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
